sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; as per Schedule

room_rent.note: Room category specified in the Schedule; wording does not fix a cap or category

icu.note: ICU/CCU/HDU charges covered; specific limit per Schedule

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base cover. Optional co-pay available (2.12.14) for premium discount. Co-pay also triggered if First Notification (2.12.12) or Preferred Provider Network (2.12.13) conditions are breached, as per Schedule.

sub_limits.note: Most benefits covered up to base SI. Specific sub-limits (e.g. ambulance, evacuation, preventive health check-up ₹900 reimbursement cap) as per Schedule. Underwriting-based sub-limits may apply per 4.12.

deductible.note: No deductible in base cover. Optional Floater Deductible (2.12.15) and Individual Deductible (2.12.16) available.

initial_waiting.note: Waivable via optional benefit 2.12.6 (Initial 30 Days Waiting Period Waiver)

ped_waiting.note: PED defined as diagnosed/treated within 36 months prior to policy commencement; waiting period in months as per Schedule

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list in 3.1.2 (cataract, hernia, arthritis, kidney, ENT, GI, etc.); waiting period in months per Schedule. Waivable via optional benefits 2.12.2 (Comprehensive) or 2.12.3 (Essential).

maternity.note: Maternity (childbirth, C-section, miscarriage, MTP) explicitly excluded under 3.1.16. Ectopic pregnancy is an exception and is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus (2.12.8) is an optional benefit; fixed % of base SI added each renewal up to cap in Schedule. No-Claim Bonus SI (2.12.9) also optional, capped at base SI. Inflation Protect SI (2.12.5) also optional. Rates and caps per Schedule.

restoration.note: Restore Sum Insured (2.12.11) is an optional benefit. If opted, restores SI after exhaustion; can be unlimited if Schedule specifies; available for related/unrelated illnesses as per Schedule. Not available for first claim in policy year.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Schedule

post_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Schedule

day_care.note: List hosted on Acko website; AYUSH day care also covered

domiciliary.note: Covered if treatment at home due to inability to move or non-availability of beds; minimum 3 consecutive days; reimbursement only

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH treatment covered under base SI (2.10); day care AYUSH also covered (2.3)

organ_donor.note: Donor's in-patient hospitalization for organ harvesting covered within insured's inpatient SI; donor pre/post-hosp, screening, transport not covered

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for emergency transport; limit per Schedule

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered under 2.11 including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy etc.

consumables.note: Non-payable/consumables covered only if optional benefit 2.12.1 (Waiver of Non-payable Medical Expenses) is opted; not covered in base

global_cover.note: Worldwide In-Patient Hospitalization (2.12.7) is an optional benefit; extends inpatient cover outside India; payment in INR at RBI rate

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim/policy contestable on non-disclosure/misrepresentation except fraud; enhanced SI has separate 60-month clock

grace_period.note: 30 days for renewal and for quarterly/half-yearly/annual instalment payments; 15 days for monthly instalments. No claim liability during renewal grace period.

free_look.note: Only at inception, not at renewal or porting

portability.note: As per IRDAI guidelines; waiting periods reduced by prior continuous coverage; apply 30-60 days before renewal

notable_exclusions: Maternity/childbirth, STDs (except HIV), hormonal therapies, sleep disorders, dental (non-accident), self-harm, OPD, external prosthetics, substance abuse, professional adventure sports
optional_riders: Consumables waiver, worldwide inpatient, restore SI, cumulative bonus, no-claim bonus SI, inflation protect SI, co-pay, deductible, 30-day waiver, specific illness WP waiver, preferred network, first notification discount, doctor-on-call, value-added services
